card.name: Words right before a duration number
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as for, over, and at least that come just before a number of days, hours, or times. The number itself has not appeared yet.

modes.label: for / over before duration
modes.description: The word for or over after a dose, just before a count of days or hours.

modes.label: at least before a count
modes.description: The word least in at least, before a number of weeks or hours.
modes.example: administer all immunizations according to immunization guidelines at<< least>> 4 weeks prior to initiation of U

modes.label: Spanish shake instruction
modes.description: The verb ending in a Spanish instruction just before a count like 10 veces.

card.writes: It pushes the model to write a specific count such as ten, and away from vague quantities like several.
card.plain: It fires on the little word just before a number of days, hours or times, so the model expects a specific count.
